children: Resources Connection appointed Jessica Block as Interim Chief Financial Officer effective October 3, 2026, following the resignation of Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Jennifer Y. Ryu effective October 2, 2026.
Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
Chief AI Officer; Interim Chief Financial Officer (will assume principal financial and accounting officer responsibilities)
Jessica Block to assume interim CFO responsibilities effective Oct 3, 2026
Interim role; continued reporting to CEO

Joined company March 2026; prior roles include EVP Head of Growth & Transformation at Factor Law (Jun 2022–Mar 2026), interim CFO at Factor (Jan 2023–Jan 2024), Senior Managing Director at Ankura (Aug 2016–May 2021); Yale BA; MBA from UVA Darden
